content.text:
Nanjing's international schools fall into roughly three price levels. All figures are annual tuition in RMB and come from the most recent schedules I could find. Some are third-party listings, so check with each school before you decide.

## Comparison

| School | Curriculum | Annual tuition (RMB) | Who can enrol |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nanjing International School (NIS) | IB | ~191,500–292,800 | Foreign passports |
| British School of Nanjing (BSN) | English curriculum, IGCSE, A Level | ~122,000–287,000 | Foreign passports |
| BASIS Nanjing | US curriculum, AP | ~217,560–288,920 | Foreign passports |
| EtonHouse Nanjing | IB PYP and British | ~124,000–181,000 | Foreign passports |
| Nanjing Foreign Language School (international programmes) | Canadian, A Level, IB, AP | ~60,000–84,000 | Mainly local students |

## Details by school

**NIS (most expensive).** For 2026–27, returning students pay
191,500 for full-day Pre-K, 266,940 for Kindergarten to Grade 5, and 274,800 for Grades 6–12
. New students pay
RMB 284,940 for Kindergarten to Grade 5 and RMB 292,800 for Grades 6 to 12, each including an RMB 18,000 new student fee.
NIS is the only independent, non-profit international school in Nanjing.
Grade 12 parents also pay the IB exam fees
, and
buses cost RMB 925 to 2,350 a month depending on distance.
**BSN (Nord Anglia).**
Annual tuition ranges from RMB 121,919 to RMB 286,640 for 2026/27
. The low end is half-day Pre-Nursery. The 2025–26 schedule listed
full-day Nursery through age 4 at 213,145 (206,750 if paid in one go) and Years 1–5 at 262,825 (245,940 paid annually)
. Other costs:
RMB 2,500 to apply, a refundable RMB 12,000 deposit and a one-off RMB 10,000 enrolment fee
, plus
an EAL charge of RMB 18,000
for students who need English support. On the plus side,
lunch is free for full-day students

.

**BASIS Nanjing.** One fee directory lists
. I couldn't confirm this on the school's own site, and one 2026 guide says to
ask the school for its current fee schedule

.

**EtonHouse (cheapest of the schools for foreign passport holders).** The 2025/26 fees ran from
RMB 124,000 for Nursery 2 (age 2)
up to
RMB 181,000 per year for Grades 11 and 12
. Some listings show "RMB 2,500" as the bottom of the range, but that's the
non-refundable registration fee for new students

, not tuition. Meals and uniforms have been charged separately.

**Nanjing Foreign Language School (budget option).** This is a public school with international programmes.
Annual tuition ranges from RMB 60,000 to RMB 84,000 for 2026/27.
Exam fees for IGCSE, A Level, IB and AP
are charged in addition to tuition.

## Things to know
- **Wycombe Abbey Nanjing has closed.** One guide reports it
closed at the end of the 2025–26 school year, in June 2026
. It offered families
transfers to Changzhou with tuition unchanged and boarding fees waived, plus a Nanjing-to-Changzhou shuttle bus.

- **Price levels:** NIS, BSN and BASIS cost about RMB 190,000–290,000 a year, EtonHouse about RMB 120,000–180,000, and the public-school international programmes about RMB 60,000–85,000.
- **Total cost:** Add new-student and enrolment fees, buses, exam fees and uniforms. These can add RMB 10,000–40,000 or more in the first year.
- **Compared with other cities:** NIS is
at the premium end of Nanjing's international school market

, but still costs less than similar IB schools in Shanghai or Beijing.

If you tell me your child's age or grade and whether you hold a foreign passport, I can narrow this down to the exact fees for the schools that fit.
